claims.assertion: Swaruu 9 describes Operation Venus Heaven as an SSP invasion beginning in 1959; Anéeka says it may have continued through 1972–75 under Vietnam-war cover.
claims.speaker: Swaruu (9); Anéeka
claims.qualifiers: Anéeka gives the end date tentatively.

claims.assertion: Anéeka says Earth’s Cabal controls Venus, where it maintains a transhumanist society and uses jump rooms to visit elite resorts.
claims.speaker: Anéeka

claims.assertion: Yazhi says many Venusian nations were destroyed and Earth humans implanted; their identities may remain human depending on belief and each body-suit’s contents.
claims.speaker: Yazhi
claims.qualifiers: She says indigenous Venusian populations also existed.

proposed_topics.name: Humanity as a shared biological suit
